natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests signup and onboarding simplification can improve early adoption. A small guarded test directly targets both issues without the renewal risk of deep discounts. Downstream qualified-revenue impact should still be monitored because early activation gains may not translate into durable, high-value accounts.
